text: Drosophila Mind bomb (D-mib), an ortholog of zebrafish Mind bomb, is a RING-type E3 ubiquitin ligase promoting Notch signaling, which regulates pattern formation in animal development via Notch and its Delta/Serrate/LAG2 (DSL) ligands. Delta is ubiquitinated by two unrelated E3 ligases, Neuralized (Drosophila, Xenopus) and Mind bomb (zebrafish), both promoting Delta endocytosis and signaling. D-mib is required for multiple Neuralized-independent, Notch-dependent developmental processes and associates physically and functionally with Serrate and Delta. Its ligase activity promotes DSL ligand activity, correlated with induced endocytosis and degradation of Delta and Serrate (Le Borgne et al., 2005). D-mib functionally replaces Neuralized in cell fate decisions absolutely requiring endogenous Neuralized, showing highly similar activities of these unrelated ligases. Thus ubiquitination of Delta and Serrate by Neuralized and D-mib is an obligate feature of DSL ligand activation throughout Drosophila development.
